card.name: Words after 'not currently' or 'other than'
card.fires_on: The word right after a phrase that points to something already in place, such as 'not currently', 'other than those', 'any other' or 'had replaced'. It is mostly a verb or noun like using, used, treated, other, or city.

modes.label: Not currently on a therapy
modes.description: Verb after 'patients not (currently)' in dosing instructions for people who are not on a drug.
modes.example: Starting LILETTA in patients not currently<< using>> hormonal or intrauterine contraception LILE

modes.label: Other than / any other
modes.description: Word after a phrase that sets apart or adds to something already named.
modes.example: to fosinopril, to any<< other>> ACE inhibitor, to hydrochlorothiaz

modes.label: History: earlier replaced
modes.description: Word in historical prose about something that came before or was replaced.

card.writes: It lowers words meaning 'already' or 'existing' (already, existing, known), so the next word is less likely to be one that stresses a prior state.
card.plain: It fires on the word after phrases like 'patients not currently' or 'other than those', where the text refers to what is already in use or in place.
